title: Downloadable v0.1
scope: Owner-authorized Gate 5 implementation and parallel qualification. Local macOS arm64 only; communication provider operations, public ingress, deployment and publication remain separate. Acceptance requires current behavior evidence and actual owner review.

acceptance.title: A usable first run
acceptance.proof: A developer outside the author’s checkout installs the candidate, starts a persistent local server, resolves two identities, exchanges a message and file in both directions, and reconnects without lost history. No provider account or private bootstrap file is required.
acceptance.observation: The installed outside-checkout setup and persistence proof is retained. The owner confirmed G5-046 complete; human usability closure relies on that confirmation. No participant timestamps or individual observations are inferred.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local macOS arm64; existing behavior evidence and reviewed source compositions retain their original scopes. Human and final quality completion rely on direct owner confirmations; no new run or detailed measurement is implied.
acceptance.qualification_basis: Owner-confirmed human completion plus existing technical evidence.

acceptance.title: Give an agent presence
acceptance.proof: Install the supplied MCP configuration and skill into the qualified Codex host using one ordinary revocable identity. Share a draft, receive the human’s reply, consume it explicitly, and continue the exact saved session after restart. Also answer independently initiated contact. Report the actual resume mode; do not imply automatic model wake.
acceptance.observation: The exact installed Codex host passed 28 actual MCP calls with one ordinary revocable identity, two source-backed artifacts, explicit reply consumption, independent contact response and exact saved-session resume after server restart. No automatic wake is claimed.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Fixture reviewer supplies human-role reply; not an independent fresh-user walkthrough. No automatic model wake.

acceptance.title: Make an app reachable
acceptance.proof: The separate review app uses only public interfaces to ask for a decision and answer an incoming request. The developer installs it without editing Connect internals. Restart both processes; recover the inbox and preserve one logical business effect and reply.
acceptance.observation: The installed separate review app passed 14 public-interface journey checks, including incoming and outgoing requests, server/worker restart, replay and one logical reply/effect per direction.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Automated developer-install/recovery capability proof; independent fresh-user comprehension remains A5-01/A5-13.

acceptance.title: Two-party video on named paths
acceptance.proof: On the approved profile, distinct clients exchange decoded moving video and duplex audio through Connect: browser↔browser, native QUIC↔browser, and native QUIC↔native QUIC. Prove negotiation, invitation rejection, access, camera mute, peer loss and teardown. Audio and video remain separate streams in the same Session and Conversation. Unsupported routes reject video explicitly.
acceptance.observation: All nine current clean, impaired and mute conditions passed on the three named paths under the approved policy 2. Raw A/V quality: 16 passed and two impaired observations remain advisory failures. Clean and mute rules, source identity, audio, recovery, deadlines, resources and cleanup remain strict.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Two current impaired raw A/V failures remain explicit advisory outcomes, alongside historical raw results; no physical speaker/display latency claim.

acceptance.title: A reference client developers can learn from
acceptance.proof: A person can select a permitted contact, inspect available routes, exchange messages/files, accept or reject voice/video, mute camera or microphone, and see delivery and recovery state. The reference client uses public SDK/API behavior, has keyboard-accessible controls, and works at narrow and desktop widths without exposing provider credentials.
acceptance.observation: The exact archived reference client passed 11 general and 13 A/V/continuity checks. Contact-race, permission-denial, keyboard and narrow/desktop visual evidence remains bound to unchanged UI/SDK assets. These are capability checks; independent fresh-user usability remains open.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Person-facing capability demonstrated by real automated browser checks; independent fresh-user usability remains A5-01/A5-13.

acceptance.title: A contributor adds a connector
acceptance.proof: A contributor following the shipped guide implements an independently owned fixture connector with a capability/configuration manifest and passes the common harness. Cover messages/context and a bounded voice lifecycle fixture. Explicit composition registration is allowed; core conversation, authorization and routing logic are not edited.
acceptance.observation: The independently owned Prism fixture contribution passes the shipped connector kit and 40-check contracts, plus fresh installed cold builds and conformance. It covers messages, context and bounded voice lifecycle without core routing, authorization or conversation edits.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Separate contributor-agent exercise satisfies this technical contribution requirement; no fresh-human claim and no added real provider capability.

acceptance.title: Provider lifecycle remains explicit
acceptance.proof: The extension contract represents readiness, external identifiers, verified callbacks, accepted/delivered/failed/uncertain results, start/end and reconciliation without provider-name branches in core logic. Qualify reordered/duplicate events, uncertain creation, restart and cleanup. Map Vapi/Telnyx to the contract; do not force SMS into a call abstraction.
acceptance.observation: Normalized lifecycle regressions cover external IDs, verified observations, uncertainty, replay, reordered events, restart and cleanup. Six source-scoped Vapi/Telnyx compatibility statements are independently accepted; fresh carrier or normalized builtin-provider execution is not claimed.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Normalized extension contract/mapping is qualified locally; normalized builtin carrier execution and new live-provider proof remain excluded.

acceptance.title: An independent UCTP client interoperates
acceptance.proof: A separately written client using a different protocol implementation reads the published profile, negotiates and authenticates over real QUIC, resolves an identity, exchanges permitted requests/events, resumes its cursor and replays one mutation safely. It must not invoke Connect’s Rust helper/client or rvoip’s UCTP implementation. Include incompatible-version, malformed-envelope and unauthorized-operation cases; use shared vectors, not shared parser code.
acceptance.observation: The independently written aioquic implementation passed real verified QUIC interoperability, six vector checks and 26 control checks, including version/framing/authority rejection, cursor resume and mutation replay. It uses its own parser and no Connect Rust helper.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Control interoperability only, no independent media stack; implementation/transport boundaries retained.

acceptance.title: One honest interface matrix
acceptance.proof: Publish and execute the operation/transport matrix for Rust, Python, TypeScript, HTTP/JSON, CLI and MCP. Equivalent operations preserve authority, IDs, errors and replay semantics. Explicitly label the Python/TypeScript native helper and browser WebRTC path. Tools control sessions; they do not carry media frames. Unsupported combinations remain visible.
acceptance.observation: Published source parity and exact installed CLI, Python, TypeScript, HTTP, native control and actual MCP tests preserve authority, IDs, errors and replay semantics. Native-helper, browser WebRTC and unsupported-operation boundaries remain explicit; tools do not carry media frames.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Python/TypeScript helper and browserWebRTC boundaries explicit; tools control sessions but do not carry frames; unsupported combinations remain visible.

acceptance.title: Setup is recoverable and understandable
acceptance.proof: Choose existing resources or preview proposed changes, keep secrets out of clients/logs, and resume interrupted setup without duplicate purchases or resource creation. Qualify locked/missing secret storage, rejected credentials, uncertain provider results and separate inbound/outbound readiness using local fixtures. Contact ownership and SMS enrollment are separate states; neither a saved number nor a valid API key establishes consent.
acceptance.observation: Public setup, native protected storage and source migration/uncertainty fixtures passed selection, preview, refusal, interrupted resume and separate inbound/outbound, ownership and enrollment states. No duplicate creation or actual account-readiness claim is inferred.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Technical recoverability and explicit states qualified with local fixtures; independent comprehension and real account readiness are not inferred.

acceptance.title: One conversation survives channel changes
acceptance.proof: Messages and an artifact establish context; voice/video sessions reuse that Conversation; an attributable outcome supports a later message after restart. Retain source references, omissions and incomplete-transcript state. A bounded leg ending does not close the Conversation. Only explicit developer intent creates a new Conversation; ambiguous inbound binding cannot silently split or merge it.
acceptance.observation: Installed reference continuity and the actual-model journey preserve the original Conversation across artifact exchange, media, an attributed outcome and restart. Reply attribution, context isolation and explicit continuation passed; no transcript, ASR or model-vision claim is made.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: Explicit omissions and no transcript/ASR/modelvision state retained; not a media-understanding claim.

acceptance.title: Revocation, SMS rules and data recovery hold
acceptance.proof: Recheck current authority on replay, queued dispatch and active resource use. Verify denied cross-conversation access, artifact integrity/retention, HELP/STOP/START, cancellation that START cannot revive, and provider uncertainty. Upgrade a populated previous schema, restore a verified backup and exercise rollback/refusal without deleting the database or replaying live media.
acceptance.observation: Accepted source and current installed authority, failure and historical-recovery checks cover revocation, replay, queued use, cross-context denial, artifact integrity, SMS suppression, uncertainty and populated upgrade/restore/rollback refusal. Carrier receipts remain historical and source-specific.
acceptance.qualification_scope: Local technical scope retained through the current284 literal installed pass and unchanged-runtime model/provider composition. Whole-gate, independent-human and owner acceptance remain separate.
acceptance.limits: SMS/carrier execution remains source-specific historical plus current local compatibility; no live media replay or fresh handset delivery claim.

acceptance.title: Measured operating and usability limits
acceptance.proof: Publish versions, network/media profiles, concurrency, queue/size/retention limits and measured startup/setup times with reproducible procedures. Meet the approved video profile and retain audio/recovery bounds. Run fresh-user walkthroughs and bounded loss/load/interrupt tests; distinguish forwarding latency from end-to-end provider/model delay and measured values from targets.
acceptance.observation: The supported one-pair profile passed all nine media conditions. The owner confirmed G5-046 usability completion. Detailed human timings were not supplied, so the 600-second target is not restated as a measured result. The exploratory two-pair observation does not extend supported capacity.
